name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation
prompts.template: Write a detailed script for a YouTube video about: {topic}
prompts.use_case: Automating YouTube video content creation for content creators

prompts.name: voiceover_customization
prompts.template: Generate a voiceover in {voice_language} with {voice_accent} accent for this script: {script}
prompts.use_case: Rapid production of educational or marketing videos without manual effort

prompts.name: video_creation
prompts.template: Create a video using the following script and voiceover audio: {script} | {voiceover_audio}
prompts.use_case: Hands-free scaling of YouTube channels using AI content generation

prompts.name: upload_prompt
prompts.template: Upload the video file {video_file} to YouTube channel with credentials {upload_credentials}
prompts.use_case: Experimenting with AI-driven multimedia content pipelines
